conviction_note: The issuer's own agenda confirms the event: Q3 2026 results on 11 Nov with a 10:00 webinar, filed before the open as the H1 filings were. Nothing in the hunt is unpublished company-level information. Monthly portability data, the Q2 counterparty read from Telefonica and the guidance arithmetic all point mildly toward an in-line-to-slightly-better quarter inside the reiterated FY26 guide, so p_up is 52. abs_move_pct is 4.5: the numbers are new (no trading update), but the guide is likely reiterated (2.3% measured base), the free float is about 11% on $0.4m/day of turnover, and the only print as a listed company moved -0.6%. The findings sum to +0.3, the same small positive lean as the scaled +0.18. They agree in sign and neither carries conviction.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 commercial momentum, read from monthly portability data, held level with Q2: about 434k gross portings in Q3 (1.345m Jan-Sep less 910.6k in Q1+Q2), September was the year's best net month after February (+59k net), and YTD growth decelerated from +22% in Q1 to about +10% through October.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Only one print as a listed company: on the H1 release day (2026-08-13, pre-open) the stock moved -0.62% (Yahoo tape), with revenue +15.7% and guidance reiterated. No measured history of a revenue surprise.
findings.source_date: 2026-11 (snippet_only: 403 to WebFetch; figure corroborated by roams.es and elgrupoinformatico snippets)
findings.original_quote: Digi rebasa las 1,5 millones de portabilidades hasta octubre y crece un 10% (headline; snippet_only). Translation: Digi passes 1.5 million portings through October, growing 10%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Monthly portability data is published and widely reported in Spain, and 12 analysts (stockanalysis.com) model it. Gross portings are a gross-adds proxy, not revenue or churn. If the market had read the deceleration as a problem the stock would have de-rated after the October data. It fell about 3% over Nov 5-10 but sits near its 20-day level (-0.47%), so there is no visible verdict.
findings.independence: Q1/Q2 gross portings (492k / 418.6k) from forbes.es https://forbes.es/economia/899244/digi-registra-su-mejor-trimestre-historico-al-sumar-mas-de-492-000-portabilidades-hasta-marzo-un-22-mas/ ; September net figure from roams.es https://roams.es/actualidad/telefonia/telefonica-gana-clientes-septiembre-digi-masorange-pierde-450000-2026/ (snippet_only, 403)

findings.finding: Counterparty read: Telefonica's wholesale revenue fell 12.4% YoY in Q2 2026 to EUR 1,358m, explicitly attributed to Digi using less of Telefonica's fixed and mobile infrastructure. That is Digi's own-network migration, which carries the 'owner economics' margin expansion Digi credits for its 20.4% Q2 margin.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin is inside the 'low 20s%' guide. The H1 margin step-up (20.2%) produced a -0.62% day.
findings.original_quote: Los ingresos mayoristas caen un 12,4% en el segundo trimestre, hasta 1.358 millones ... El operador rumano, que ya utiliza menos la infraestructura fija y móvil de Telefónica. Translation: Wholesale revenue falls 12.4% in Q2 to EUR 1,358m ... the Romanian operator already uses less of Telefonica's fixed and mobile infrastructure.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. It is a Q2 data point that reached Digi's own H1 margin and the reiterated guide. Telefonica's Q3 2026 counterpart was not found. If it had shown a sharper wholesale fall it would be a fresh read, and its absence is why this stays small.
findings.independence: Digi's own H1 deck: 'Adj EBITDA margin increased to 20.4% in Q2 2026, reflecting scale benefits of the owner economics model' https://www.digispain.es/download/pdf/202608130811206528_presentacion-de-los-resultados-del-prime.pdf (same causal chain, so it is one fact counted once)

findings.finding: Guidance arithmetic: H1 revenue of EUR 515m against FY EUR 1,040-1,085m requires H2 of EUR 525-570m. Q2's EUR 263m run-rate plus the EUR 272.4m Q3 estimate puts the year near the midpoint, so the most likely release outcome is a reiteration or tight narrowing, not a change.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance was reiterated once as a listed company (2026-08-13, -0.62% day). Measured European base: reiterated guidance, median move 2.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: Inside what the company guided, so mostly priced. The small positive is the asymmetry that a midpoint run-rate leaves more room to narrow upward than to cut. No document says a change is coming.
findings.independence: TradingView scanner Q3 revenue estimate EUR 272.4m https://scanner.tradingview.com/spain/scan ; Q3 2025 revenue EUR 236.1m (forbes.es https://forbes.es/?p=828128), so +15.4% YoY in line with Q2's +15.1%

findings.finding: The 19 Oct 2026 EGM revoked 'for just cause' the sitting auditor of the consolidated accounts for 2026-2027 and appointed a new auditor for 2026-2028, all items approved with 94.38% quorum. This aligns with the parent's appointment of Deloitte as group auditor for FY2026 (parent EGM 15 Sep). In Spanish law 'justa causa' is the legal formula needed to remove an auditor mid-term, not a disclosed dispute.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: none; the stock moved -0.63% on 2026-10-20 and +0.40% on 10-27
findings.original_quote: Revocación del nombramiento por justa causa del auditor vigente de cuentas consolidadas de la Sociedad y de su grupo para los ejercicios 2026-2027. Segundo: Nombramiento de auditor de cuentas de la Sociedad y de su grupo consolidado para los ejercicios 2026-2028. Translation: Revocation for just cause of the current auditor of the consolidated accounts of the Company and its group for 2026-2027. Second: appointment of the auditor of the Company and its consolidated group for 2026-2028.
findings.why_not_priced: Public and immaterial to the quarter: Q3 figures are unaudited. It would matter only if the release disclosed a restatement, and no document suggests one.
